answer: Make the recruiter liable. When a recruit's submission fails a panel or repeats an earlier answer, burn half the recruiter's bond alongside the recruit's and publish the burn. Duplicates are found by replaying the answer text against the ledger, not by checking display names, so a walnut of renamed clones still trips. An island of accounts therefore puts the inviter's capital at risk on every member, and the plume of cheap referrals farms rely on becomes a liability instead of an asset.
